deadline.value: The College of Engineering table gives March 1 for international Fall applicants and July 1 for domestic and Mexican applicants.
deadline.quote: Electrical and Computer Engineering (PHD) Mar 1 (I) July 1 (D & MX)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is named.

supervisor.value: The fetched pages do not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The fetched pages do not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: A BS or MS in electrical or computer engineering, or a related field, is accepted; a master's can be completed before candidacy.
entry_route.quote: If you have not completed the master's degree before entering the doctoral program, you will be required to complete it as part of the requirements for candidacy

also.quote: with a minimum GPA of 3.3/4.0 (or its equivalent)

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for admission, but applicants may submit it.
gre_general.quote: The graduate record examination (GRE) is not required for admission, but students are encouraged to submit the results if they take the exam

notes: International applicants with equivalent education need a minimum GPA of 3.3 on a 4.0 scale.
name: Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering
